environment.machine: Windows 11 10.0.26200 x64 (same machine for both tools)
environment.nodesify_graphify: 0.8.0 prebuilt native binary via npm (@nodesify/graphify), commit 44560ae for self-corpus
environment.original_graphify: safishamsi/graphify commit 91f4d12 (pyproject v0.1.14), Python 3.12.12 venv (uv), graspologic/networkx as pinned by its pyproject

methodology: Same corpus, same machine: the original Python graphify's own repository at commit 91f4d12 (90 detect entries, ~0.5 MB text).

Both tools ran the structural pipeline only: detect -> AST extract -> build -> cluster -> analyze -> report. No LLM enrichment on either side (the original's semantic layer is Claude-subagent-driven and was skipped per its own code-only fast path; ours was simply not configured).

The original was driven by a script replicating its skill.md exactly: detect() -> collect_files()/extract() -> build_from_json() -> cluster()/score_all() -> god_nodes()/surprising_connections() -> generate()/to_json().

Each tool's token benchmark is its own implementation (ours was ported from upstream's): corpus tokens are estimated from real file sizes with each tool's own estimator, and query cost is each tool's own answer-size model on five fixed questions. The comparable metric is each tool's ratio on the same corpus, not the absolute token estimates.
Timings are wall clock, best of a single cold run per tool (no prior caches for either).

embedding_experiment.description: nodesify-graphify run with and without --embed (local model, no API key). Numbers from fresh runs on v0.8.0.

self_corpus.corpus: this repository at commit 44560ae (git-tracked files only, 191 files, 1.3 MB)

embedding_experiment.finding: similar_to edges consolidate communities 428 -> 201 (-53%) on the self corpus and 161 -> 91 (-44%) on the Python corpus. The token ratio is unchanged (~109x / ~51.5x): embeddings add semantic recall, not compression.
